<b>Undercranks</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are heavy, hard-shelled [[Underworkers]] who have risen above the other workers, tasked with repairing the [[Underworks]].<ref>Undercrank [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Heavy, hard-shelled worker, forever repairing the Citadel's crumbling Underworks. There seem no ranks in their domain, yet this one has risen above the rest."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Undercranks often start off stationary at work, but begin to attack [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] once they notice her, wandering naturally if she gets out of detection range. When she is in range, they perform any of the following attacks:
* <b>Shortswing:</b> Readies their long twistpin before performing a short, low swing at Hornet. This attack has heavy backswing, leaving them extremely open once they miss.
** If Hornet gets behind the Undercrank during any part of this move's animation, they turn around with a follow-up overhead swing at her. 
* <b>Jump Slam:</b> Performs a short jump before slamming their twistpin down as they land, also having heavy backswing. This attack is easily dodged by dashing backwards, and immediately leaves them open to counterattack.
** A different version of this attack happens if they spawn from the ceiling in some of the [[Underworks]] many arenas. In this scenario, they fall straight down and perform the overhead swing as they land.
* <b>Shell Retreat:</b> Retracts into their bulky shell, which blocks all Needle attacks and most [[Tools]] and moves backwards a set distance.

Undercranks deal {{Damage|2}} for all attacks, as well as contact damage.<br>
Undercranks' sturdy shells make them immune to all attacks from behind that don't pierce armour or blocks.

While they may seem threatening at first glance, Undercranks are easy to defeat. Their incredibly slow and poorly controlled attacks constantly leave them open, and they hardly have any more range than Hornet. Keeping pressure on them whilst jumping when required can net an easy victory over these brutes.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Undercranks have their health doubled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Undercranks can be found primarily in the [[Underworks]], with one encountered as part of the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Underworks 1|enemy gauntlet]] in the northwest of the area, two in the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Underworks 2|gauntlet]] in the middle of the area, and another during the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Underworks 3|gauntlet]] in [[the Cauldron]]. One Undercrank drops from the ceiling when a [[Craftmetal]] deposit in the lower part of the Cauldron is struck, but never appears again once the deposit is broken.

A [[black-threaded]] Undercrank is fought during the [[Enemy Gauntlets (Silksong)/Cogwork Core 2|gauntlet]] in the ruined [[Cogwork Core]] at the beginning of [[Act 3]].
